content.text: Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195. If you're in Nigeria, Pakistan, or Zimbabwe, you're excluded. PayPal can suspend your account and hold funds for 180 days without appeal. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle follow the same geographic restrictions. This isn't an accident. It's structural. This post explains how to build digital commerce infrastructure that doesn't depend on any of these platforms. Own the stack. Own the revenue.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack you own and control. No third-party platforms. No geographic restrictions. No fund holds. It combines free and paid tools into a unified system: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and crypto payment processing. The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-what-nobody-tells-15|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-software-without-stripe-account-8|The Real]]-behind-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-13|architecture]] is designed to work in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It's not a workaround. It's base-layer infrastructure. You deploy it once. You own it forever. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for static site hosting (free). Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic (free). Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data (free). Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers digital products (free). NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. When a buyer sends payment, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. The webhook fires your backend logic to deliver the product automatically. The system is stateless, serverless, and platform-independent.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products. If you're in a country where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Paddle is unavailable or unreliable, this stack gives you structural independence. It's also built for creators who want to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. No platform can suspend your account, hold your funds, or change their terms on you. You control the entire stack from hosting to payment processing.
Stripe's 46-country limit is not a bug. It's a feature of their architecture. Build your own.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles order processing and product delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores your digital products. NOWPayments handles crypto payments and triggers webhooks when payments confirm. The components are integrated through APIs and webhooks. Each component is replaceable. If one tool becomes unavailable or unreliable, you can swap it out without rebuilding the entire stack. The architecture is modular, stateless, and platform-independent.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Test the entire stack end-to-end before going live. If you want a fully deployed stack in 48 hours with 30-day support, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, and end-to-end testing.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This architecture bypasses geographic restrictions and gives you full ownership of your commerce infrastructure. No platform can suspend your account or hold your funds.
PayPal can hold your funds for 180 days. Sovereign infrastructure can't.

If you're looking for a Stripe alternative in Nigeria or a Gumroad alternative in Pakistan, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a fully deployed solution available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, and end-to-end testing. For a DIY approach, start with the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation and source code. Both options give you structural independence from restricted platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Upload digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Test the stack end-to-end. Deploy to production. Monitor transaction webhooks. Scale as needed. For a fully deployed stack in 48 hours, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I'm in Nigeria or Pakistan?

Yes. The stack is designed for regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or unreliable. It uses globally accessible tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction fees under $0.10.
Can I swap out components later?
Yes. The architecture is modular. If a component becomes unavailable or unreliable, you can replace it without rebuilding the entire stack.
Do I need to know how to code?
Basic technical knowledge is helpful but not required. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes complete documentation and source code. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is fully deployed for you.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it goes down, your stack will queue transactions and process them when the service is restored. You can also integrate a backup payment processor using the same webhook logic.
Modular stacks are future-proof. Replace components without rebuilding everything.
